data.name: Luhaifah
data.gender_notes: Luhaifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Luhaifah means 'gentle, tender' in Arabic. It is a unisex name that signifies softness and kindness. The name Luhaifah carries the meaning “Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Luhaifah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being gentle and kind in all actions and interactions.
data.etymology: Luhaifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luhaifah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: لوحيفة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني المرأة الحسناء أو الحاملة للوح أو الكتاب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لوحيفة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي لوح، ويعني المرأة التي تحمل اللوح أو الكتاب، أو المرأة الحسناء التي تترك انطباعا جميلا، وقد ورد في بعض الروايات أنه كان يطلق على نساء من السابقين اللاتي كن يحملن الكتب أو اللواحق الدينية، مما يعكس قيمة العلم والكتابة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: لوحيفة
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت عورت یا کتاب کی حامل
in_urdu.long_meaning: لوحيفة نام عربی मूल کا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت عورت یا وہ عورت جو کتاب یا لوح رکھتی ہے۔ یہ نام علم و حکمت اور خوبصورتی کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں، یہ نام علمی فضیلت اور روحانی خوبصورتی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लुहैफा
in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर महिला या पुस्तक की वाहक
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुहैफा नाम का अर्थ है सुंदर महिला या पुस्तक की वाहक। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में ज्ञान, बुद्धिमत्ता और सौंदर्य का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम विद्या और पवित्रता की निशानी माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: لوحيفه
in_pashto.meaning: ښايسته ښځه يا د کتاب حامل
in_pashto.long_meaning: د لوحيفه نوم په پښتو کې ښايسته ښځه يا د کتاب حامل معنی لري. دا نوم د پښتنو دودیزو ارزښتونو او د اسلامي علم او پوهې د ستاينګ لپاره کارول کېږي. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم د ښځو لپاره د ښوګڼې او پوهې د نماينده ګرځي.

in_english.name: Luhaifah
in_english.meaning: Beautiful woman or carrier of the book/scripture
in_english.long_meaning: Luhaifah originates from the Arabic root 'L-W-H', meaning 'to carry' or 'to bear'. It signifies a beautiful woman or one who carries a book/scripture. In Islamic tradition, the name Luhaifah embodies the qualities of knowledge, beauty, and piety. Historically, it may refer to women known for their wisdom or their role in preserving and spreading religious texts. The name Luhaifah is associated with positive attributes such as intelligence, spirituality, and grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Luhaifah evokes a sense of warmth and calmness. It is a name that reflects the gentle and tender nature of the Islamic culture. In a society that places a high value on respect, kindness, and hospitality, Luhaifah serves as a reminder of the softness and compassion that is expected of every Muslim. It is a name that is often bestowed upon children as a reminder of the importance of treating others with kindness and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Luhaifah represents the gentle and tender nature of Allah (God) towards His creation. It is a reminder of the mercy and compassion that Allah extends to all beings. In a spiritual sense, Luhaifah inspires individuals to embody the qualities of kindness, gentleness, and compassion in their daily lives, just as Allah is compassionate towards His creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Luhaifah means "the one who is careful with her oaths and promises." It symbolizes an individual who is trustworthy, reliable, and upholds integrity in their words and actions. This name reflects the importance of sincerity and honesty in Islamic values.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham, Sirah Ibn Hisham, p. 134 The name Luhaifah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Luhaifah bint Al-Harith was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was known for her generosity and hospitality. She was the wife of Sa'd ibn Mu'adh, the governor of Kufa, and is mentioned in several hadiths.

platforms: Arabic language social media, Islamic websites
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Luhaifah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Luhaifah in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Luhaifah, which means "Gentle". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
